surface: .agentic/procedures/ (initial data-driven procedures: feedback-integration, nightly-drift-detection, cost-rollup), src/plate_core/autonomy.py (ProcedureDef, _load_procedures, tick_schedules, run_procedure with risk gate), src/plate_core/mcp_server.py (plate_autonomy_list_procedures + run_procedure wiring + filter by tol), plate_config extension support if contributed, docs/research + design notes, .agentic/releases/unreleased/ fragment (this slice)
summary: Adds built-in procedures registry + initial .agentic/procedures/*.json (nightly drift detection, feedback integration via babysit, weekly cost rollup) with engine support (load from dir, tick by cadence/risk, run_procedure with basic risk gating and logging). Cross updates for autonomy surfaces (mcp list filtered by risk_tolerance, cli/mcp hooks). This is the procedures registry + engine dispatch slice of the Autonomous PLATE Engine (Epic #470 / #478). Full governor, CLI surfaces, observability in siblings.
migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repos can now place .agentic/procedures/*.json for scheduled/risk-gated work (cadence, risk_level, enabled). Engine (via plate_autonomy_* or gh plate autonomy) will tick/run only those <= current .plate autonomy.risk_tolerance. Procedures are opt-in via files; no behavior change unless .plate autonomy enabled and procedures present.
agent_notes: Use .agentic/procedures/ for recurring safe steps (e.g. drift, babysit, cost). Engine filters by risk; run via MCP/CLI with dry_run support. Extend with custom json for your flows (steps as allow-listed tools). Quiet ops and budget gates apply.
migration_guidance: Create .agentic/procedures/ and add json files for desired recurring work (see initial examples: feedback-integration uses plate_pr_babysit, etc.). Set risk_level appropriately (low/medium/high).
Ensure .plate has autonomy section with risk_tolerance (e.g. medium) so engine will consider the procedures.
Procedures execute only if their risk_level <= configured tolerance and via explicit run or scheduled tick.
